gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all notification schemes to understand how notifications are configured across different projects.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of all notification schemes available in the Jira instance.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to create a new notification scheme so that I can customize notifications for my team.
gold.ideal: Creates a new notification scheme and returns the details of the created scheme.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to see which notification schemes are mapped to my projects to ensure proper notifications are sent.
gold.ideal: Returns a mapping of notification schemes to projects.

gold.user: As a team lead, I want to view the details of a specific notification scheme to verify its configuration.
gold.ideal: Returns the details of the specified notification scheme.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to update an existing notification scheme to reflect changes in team structure.
gold.ideal: Updates the specified notification scheme and returns the updated details.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to add new notifications to a scheme to ensure all relevant team members are informed.
gold.ideal: Adds notifications to the specified notification scheme and returns the updated scheme.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to delete an obsolete notification scheme to keep our configurations clean.
gold.ideal: Deletes the specified notification scheme and confirms the deletion.

gold.user: As a team lead, I want to remove a specific notification from a scheme to reduce unnecessary alerts.
gold.ideal: Removes the specified notification from the notification scheme and returns the updated scheme.
